Gale provider unchanged (local override gale-logdet: 91aa7a18 / b011de53 / 8fb95430); local-provider evidence only.

Coherent input contract: TrialDeterminantInput(accepted: TrialAcceptedTrialBand, first, second) accepts NO factor and NO A band. TrialAcceptedTrialBand has a private constructor; its only producers are factorize(preparation, coordinates, lambda, value) and atPreparationLambda. These validate dimension/coords/lambda/shape/finite active entries (refusal receipt (1,1,0,0,0)), copy the ACTIVE band into canonical owned storage with padding zeroed, freeze it (builder closed), and Gale factorLower EXACTLY that frozen copy in the same call (receipt factorAttempts/Failures (1,0,1,1,0) on non-SPD, (1,0,1,0,N(b+1)) admitted), separate from evaluation work. The bundle binds preparation, coordinates, lambda, the frozen band and its factor. evaluate reuses bundle.factor and bundle.band: zero additional N factorisation. Residual admission is unchanged and documented as solve quality, not identity. FactorShape is removed (unreachable).

Evidence via ROOT/run-sbt.py:
- logs/trial-ml-helper-repair-final.log (SHA-256 6963bbc472d969a575adb8b000448261bafea6e2753d71671c4981ad2ddb9ba7; meta 4cfaabe847f100da1a44af7cdb2047d8206005aae32adc868a787f2415407271; exit 0; 175.3 s; finished 06:01:20Z): fitJVM/Test/clean + fitJS/Test/clean, then JVM and JS TrialConstrainedLogDetJetSuite (12) + TrialConditionalSolveSuite (5) = 17/17 each; scalafimCompileAll 0 [warn]/[error].
- New controls:
  (a) compileErrors: the pre-repair call TrialDeterminantInput(prep, at, lambda, factor, value, first, second) and new TrialAcceptedTrialBand(...) do not compile.
  (b) A2 = A1 + 1e-13 I passes the OLD hybrid residual below 1e-10 (computed with an independent dense symmetric product); A2's bundle holds the factor of its own frozen band (logDet equal to a fresh factorLower of that band; active entries bitwise equal).
  (c) canonical copy: NaN source padding becomes 0 in the bundle, active entries are bitwise equal, the closed source builder throws on write, and repeated evaluation is identical.
  (d) non-SPD factor refusal is typed and charged at creation.
- Mutants (logs/trial-ml-helper-repair-mutant{A,B,C}.log, mutantD-clean.log): unremapped packing fails 2/12; dropping one same-axis A_pU_p fails 3/12; retaining the caller's source matrix instead of the frozen copy fails 1/12; a public bundle constructor fails 1/12. Caveat: D survived a plain incremental run (logs/trial-ml-helper-repair-mutantD.log) because zinc does not recompile the suite for a constructor referenced only in a compileErrors string. It is caught under fitJVM/Test/clean, which is why the final gate cleans both test dirs. Source restored and re-verified by hash after each mutant.
- r1 failed only on an unused lambda parameter under -Werror; fixed.
Scope unchanged: no criterion/reference/executor seam, public ML, hosted pin or scientific claim.
